subject: catalog.html renders container CHILDREN flat beside their parents
description:
Pre-existing tension with the Container grouping ruling (unified-hub-registry.md): catalog.html filters only tenantAssignable/workshop, no !h.parent, so ~69 parented children (13 cortex sub-tracks, armory languages, etc) render as top-level cartridges duplicating their container's internal nav. byHouse() (north-star step 1) already excludes children for house projections; decide whether catalog should group-by-container (cartridge shelf per family) or keep flat, then implement. Found during step-1 build 2026-07-28; Nancy flagged; deliberately NOT changed in that commit.
[2026-07-31 10:53] Measured 2026-07-31: HubRegistry.js has 143 entries, 139 pass catalog's filters, and 69 of those 139 carry a parent -- so HALF the public catalog is child cards duplicating their container's internal nav. Families: code-armory 17, backbone 14, cortex 13, algorithm-chamber 9, api 7, cloud-master 6, proving-grounds/vault/signal 1 each. The three single-child families are the sharp edge for any group-by-container design. Nancy dispatched for the A-vs-B ruling.
[2026-07-31 11:05] IMPLEMENTED + committed e0e62e56c together with #243 (Nancy: they are one change; the parent filter must never ship ahead of the dynamic merge, or cloud-master's 6 children vanish with no container card). Verified by REAL headless render via the new _tools/eduscan/catalog-probe.js: 143 registry entries, 69 with a parent, 73 cards render (143-69=74 top-level, minus 1 excluded by tenantAssignable:false), and an in-page assertion confirms ZERO children leak. Also rendered with Firestore unavailable: still 73 cards, no page error -- degraded path holds. NOT deployed; Chris gate in flight. UNPROVEN: the dynamic merge itself cannot be exercised locally (ArenaFirebase needs real Firebase), so #243 is proven-fails-safely, not proven-works.
